description: We are a fully formed team for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our focus is on creative, educational, and design-oriented challenges like Earth Information Jukebox or Space Mission Design Game. We aim to blend space data with storytelling, UI/UX, and gamification to make science accessible to everyone. We are ready and excited to build an amazing project! 🚀
summary: Stormwalkers is an interactive Earth exploration project that uses NASA data to display weather information, explore locations on a 3D globe, and transform Earth data into unique sounds.
